# ETH-USD Technical Report (as of 2026-11-11)

## 1. Data integrity notes

The verified snapshot is the source of truth for every exact figure below. Two small discrepancies showed up between tools:

| Item | get_stock_data / get_indicators | Verified snapshot (used here) |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-11 close | 2072.93 | **2072.64** |
| MACD | -88.79 | **-88.81** |
| 10 EMA | 2174.35 | **2174.31** |

The differences are small and I have not reconciled them. One possible cause is that the 2026-11-11 bar was still forming when the tools ran, but the outputs do not confirm this. Other indicator values (RSI, ATR, 50/200 SMA, Bollinger middle) agree to rounding. The MACD signal, histogram and Bollinger upper and lower bands come only from the snapshot, because I did not call them separately.

## 2. Indicators selected and why (8, complementary)

- **close_10_ema** (short-term momentum and the first dynamic resistance)
- **close_50_sma** (medium-term trend)
- **close_200_sma** (long-term regime benchmark)
- **macd** (trend momentum; the snapshot supplies the signal and histogram)
- **rsi** (oversold/overbought and divergence)
- **boll** (20-period mean; the snapshot supplies the upper and lower bands)
- **atr** (volatility for stops and sizing)
- **vwma** (volume-weighted trend confirmation)

I left out the other MACD and Bollinger components as redundant to the base lines. Together the set covers trend at three horizons, momentum, mean-reversion extremes, volatility and volume.

## 3. Price structure (from OHLCV data)

- **August breakout.** ETH-USD closed around 1,843–1,916 through the first half of August. On 2026-08-19 it gapped and rallied from a 1916.46 close to 2251.46, on volume of about 29.6B, the highest in the sample apart from the 06-05 selloff. It then ran to 2776.47 on 09-21, the highest close in the window.
- **Plateau, then breakdown.** From late September to 10-06, closes held in a tight 2,668–2,726 band. On 10-07 and 10-08 price fell from 2697.52 to 2573.53 to 2471.91, and that began the current downtrend.
- **Lower highs and lower lows since 10-07:**
  - Closes: 2534.70 (10-11), 2496.63 (10-13), 2470.77 (10-21).
  - Lows: 2320.28 close (10-26), 2241.05 close (10-30), 2120.98 close (11-08), 2050.18 close (11-10).
  - The recent swing low is the 2005.43 intraday low on 11-10.
- **Failed rally on 11-04 and 11-05.** On 11-04 price spiked to a 2446.05 high and closed at 2422.31 on 17.5B volume. The next day it reversed to close at 2234.48 (low 2203.81, volume 18.7B). That is a full retracement of the rally within one session, and it shows supply near 2,400–2,450.
- **Today (11-11).** Open 2050.65, high 2094.22, low 2042.18, close 2072.64. The bounce so far is modest, and volume of 8.8B is lighter than the prior two sessions.

## 4. Indicator readings (verified values)

**Trend and moving averages**
- Price (2072.64) sits below the 10 EMA (2174.31), the 200 SMA (2150.95) and the 50 SMA (2442.60). ETH-USD is below every average in the set.
- **The 200 SMA has been lost.** The 11-07 close of 2236.32 was above it. The 11-08 close of 2120.98 was below it, and closes have stayed below since. The 200 SMA itself is nearly flat (2135.79 on 10-12, 2150.95 now, peak 2159.11 on 10-29), so it now acts as overhead resistance.
- **The 50 SMA is falling steadily**, from 2555.78 on 10-12 to 2442.60. The 50/200 gap has narrowed from about 420 to about 292 points. This is a convergence, **not a death cross**, and the data do not tell us when or whether a cross would happen.
- The 10 EMA fell from 2554.34 (10-12) to 2174.31. It is the nearest dynamic resistance, about 100 points above price.

**Momentum**
- MACD is -88.81, below its signal of -72.51, with a histogram of -16.30. MACD was -13.40 on 10-12 and has fallen to its weakest level in the window.
- There is a brief interruption on 11-03 and 11-04 (-68.75 to -54.31), caused by the 11-04 spike. It faded, and MACD resumed falling. There is no bullish crossover.
- RSI is 32.36. It touched 29.94 on 11-10 (below 30) and was 30.29 on 10-30. RSI has been in a 29.9–45.9 range since 10-12, apart from one reading of 54.08 on 11-04, which is the only reading above 46 in the window. That fits a persistent downtrend, in which RSI tends to stay depressed rather than reverting quickly.
- **No confirmed bullish divergence.** RSI lows (30.29 on 10-30, 29.94 on 11-10) are essentially equal while price made a much lower low, but the second RSI low is not higher. I would not call this a divergence signal.

**Volatility and bands**
- Bollinger middle is 2256.70, upper band 2458.72, lower band 2054.68. The middle has fallen from 2635.19 (10-12).
- Price at 2072.64 is about 18 points above the lower band. Today's intraday low (2042.18) was below the 2054.68 lower band, so the band was breached intraday. In a downtrend, price can keep walking along the lower band, so a band touch is not by itself a buy signal.
- ATR is 93.19, about 4.5% of price (my calculation). It rose from 78.86 (11-03) to a peak of 99.22 (11-05) and has eased slightly. That is elevated, trending volatility, not a quiet market.

**Volume-weighted trend**
- VWMA is 2227.75, below the 20-day mean (2256.70) and well above price. It has declined from 2621.41 on 10-12. The VWMA sitting below the 20 SMA is consistent with recent volume skewing toward lower prices, but this is an inference, not a direct volume-by-direction measurement. Volume on 11-05 (18.7B) and 11-10 (13.4B) was heavy on down moves.

## 5. Interpretation

1. **Dominant trend: bearish on short and medium horizons.** Lower highs and lows since 10-07, a loss of the 200 SMA, and a falling 10 EMA, 50 SMA, Bollinger middle and VWMA all agree.
2. **Momentum is deteriorating, not stabilizing.** MACD is below its signal with a negative histogram, and there is no bullish crossover.
3. **Oversold, but not a reversal signal.** RSI near 30 and price at the lower band suggest a bounce is possible. In this tape, oversold readings have lasted for weeks.
4. **Key regime question:** whether ETH-USD can reclaim the 2151–2174 zone (200 SMA and 10 EMA). That would put it back above its long-term average and show the 11-08 break was a false move. Failing there keeps the breakdown intact.

## 6. Levels to watch

These are reference levels drawn from the indicators and the swing points above. I am not claiming any have been validated by past bounces.

- **Overhead resistance:** 2151 (200 SMA), 2174 (10 EMA), about 2228 (VWMA), about 2257 (Bollinger middle), then 2442–2446 (50 SMA and the 11-04 high).
- **Downside references:**
  - 2054.68 (lower Bollinger band).
  - 2005.43 (11-10 swing low), which is the most important near-term level.
  - The 1,843–1,916 close range from early August. This is a prior consolidation area below the 08-19 gap, a reference rather than demonstrated support.

## 7. Scenarios and risk framework

- **Bearish continuation:** a daily close below 2005.43, with MACD histogram staying negative and RSI holding under about 35, would extend the lower-lows sequence. The next reference is the early-August consolidation area.
- **Relief bounce:** the first targets would be the 2151–2174 cluster, then the Bollinger middle. The 11-04 spike that fully reversed the next day is a caution that rallies into resistance have faded in this tape.
- **Trend-change evidence to wait for:** a close back above the 200 SMA and 10 EMA, a bullish MACD crossover (MACD above signal), and RSI recovering above its recent 40–46 ceiling.
- **Risk sizing:** a 1× ATR move is about 93 points, so a typical daily swing is wide relative to the gap between price and the 2005.43 swing low (about 67 points). A stop placed just beyond that low would sit inside one ATR and could be hit by ordinary noise. Stops of 1.5–2× ATR (roughly 140–186 points) and correspondingly smaller position sizes would be consistent with current volatility.

This report is a technical read, not a trade decision.

2. **Medium-term trend above long-term trend.** The 50-day average is about 14.1% above the 200-day average. That is a bullish moving-average structure, meaning the past ~50 days averaged higher than the past ~200. It describes the recent past, not necessarily the current price.
